summary: AI Services governed launch attempts now use unique per-attempt logs and richer process/health diagnostics for TextGen failures.
changes: Created per-attempt execution log paths under runtime/ai_services/logs/ before process start.
Recorded the current attempt log path in state, audit events, and returned execution diagnostics.
Captured current-attempt log tails only, preventing stale service log contamination.
Added process handle tracking to ProcessRunner for liveness and return-code diagnostics when available.
Added regression tests for fresh log handling and process-exit diagnostics.
